What makes a good fade

A skin fade lives or dies on the blend. Susy takes the sides down to the skin and works up through each guard until there's no visible line, then sharpens the edges so it reads clean from every angle.

Low, mid or high

  • Low fade: starts just above the ear; subtle and office-friendly.
  • Mid fade: the most popular; balanced and sharp.
  • High fade: bold contrast, pairs well with textured tops.

Not sure which suits your head shape? Ask during your appointment and Susy will recommend one.

Keeping it sharp

Fades grow out fastest of any style. Most clients rebook every two to three weeks to keep the blend tight.
